notes.title: Meadow Is Getting New Content and a Price Change
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/033ef05c74e4986c8ee9dc27e7955d8fec57a8c3.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hello![/h3]

I hope you're all well. I come bearing news about Meadow, our online multiplayer animal roleplaying game [i](mouthful, innit?)[/i], which as you may know is set in the world of Shelter. It’s been a good while since we gave you an update on the game, and as we approach the anniversary we thought we would touch base and let you know what the future for Meadow looks like - at least in broad terms. 

As many of you know we at Might and Delight have recently released Book of Travels to Early Access and rebuilt our team, and so we’ve also been able to allocate more staff and resources to the further development of Meadow. 

Whilst we aren’t ready to go into detail on exactly what we're working on today, we [i]can [/i]confirm that [b]we do indeed have plans for new features, quality of life improvements, stability updates, downloadable content[/b] and more for Meadow. In the coming weeks we will update and reveal the specific details of these plans and what it means for Meadow and the world of Shelter in general.

The development of these new features has already started, as people may have noticed with our first [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/486310/discussions/0/3806153791382993742/]beta release[/url], but as this grows it will affect the overall production cost of Meadow, and so [b]in the future we will raise the price of the game[/b]. This will also put us in a better position to support Meadow long term. We’re expecting this change will be applied in early November, to coincide with new features being released. 

Exciting times ahead, friends! Again, you’ll hear from us again soon - so stay tuned in the meantime. 

[b]Best,
Oliver & the team at Might and Delight 
[/b]

notes.title: A Message from the Team
notes.content:
[h2]Dear Shelter Lovers,[/h2]

After the hecticness of launch we wanted to pop in and respond to some of your reviews and feedback. Thank you, as always, for posting them - good and bad!

As some of you have pointed out, we did indeed design Shelter 3 as a different kind of game to its predecessors, and that was a conscious decision - we wanted to explore something new. Choosing elephants as our protagonists was an early expression of that direction: we liked that elephants are neither fast nor hunters and that their empathy and collective will make for characteristics we could design for. But in the end the game could work better, and this is a fact that can only be explained by the complexity of running development schedules for two games simultaneously. Without a doubt, building Book of Travels simultaneously has stretched our team wide and left some aspects lacking in Shelter 3.

So we're here to say that we're genuinely so sorry to hear that fans have been disappointed (we hear you) and we’re incredibly grateful to those who have stuck with us despite the hiccups and deficits they found in their game experience. We hope it helps you to know that our first patch is already up and that we will continue with a scheduled plan of patches as well as bug fixes. Now, as previously, we value your feedback and will act on it where we can.

But we should be clear that beyond fixes, Shelter 3 won’t change much. We hope that your replay experiences will bring you more satisfaction... If you’re one of the players who reviewed Shelter 3 well, thank you for spreading positive energies, as a growing and niche studio, we need and value your support in all its forms!

Thanks again for sticking with us.

[b]Best Wishes

Helen & the Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: First Patch Notes for Shelter 3
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

Thanks so much for buying Shelter 3 ! Here some the first patches.  Thanks for your reports - we are working on them! And more patches will be released on April 7th.

[h2]Content Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Drink action audio is more rewarding.
[*] Bamboo crush audio (tall, big and small) is now more crunchy.
[*] Glitch in audio file removed from elephants’ waterstep.
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Camera view on the third visit to the Matriarch’s memories is no longer blocked by rocks.
[*] Areas for music adjusted to dangers.
[*] Storks and Herons look better when taking off
[*] Rebalanced grass nutrition values
[*] Rebalanced starvation threshold
[*] Rebalanced running energy consumption
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Health no longer resets after visiting the Matriarch’s memories.
[*] Elephants should no longer get stuck when trying to walk to fruit
[*] Lotus Lake and Herons Nest “star audio” changed to “layer positive”
[*] Fixed collision on burning tree
[*] Fixed shadows on landmark stars
[*] Fixed some of the rabbits not moving.
[*] Decorative Crocodiles should now be visible in river area
[*] Glitches, clicks and pops removed from audio assets
[*] Lighting should no longer cut when arriving at a landmark
[*] Avoid landmark text overflow
[*] Player calf doesn’t look hungry before it starts calling for nursing
[*] (Mac) Fixed calves emotes looking strange and acting strange
[*] (Mac) Stars should now be visible in the Matriarch's memories scene
[*] (Mac) Fixed lagging in end scene
[*] Prevent grass from getting stuck in the elephants’ trunk
[*] Fixed elephants getting stuck behind large rocks
[*] Fixed credits view getting stuck if pressing ‘credits’ in the start menu right after ‘new game’
[/list]

We recently made  an [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/977630/view/5095219434740096474]overview of all Shelter Games[/url], but somehow we overlooked our special baby of the family [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/434000/Paws/]Paws[/url][/b]… And since Paws is five years old this month, we’re celebrating with a discount and a little bit of lynx love!

Those of you who’ve been to hell and back to save those babies in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/244710/Shelter/]Shelter[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/275100/Shelter_2/]Shelter 2[/url] will be pleased to know you can go all-out cute and play as a baby lynx cub trying to reunite with their family. Paws is a small game with a big heart and is a much-loved favourite here in the studio, and this month this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/434000/Paws/]cub-that-never-grows-up[/url] is five years old! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/434000/Paws/

[h2]A heart-warming, emotional adventure[/h2]

[b]The journey in Paws is a classic adventure that takes you to new friendships and more than the odd twist. Here’s what reviewers on Steam say about Paws:[/b]

[i]“Like any other Shelter game you find yourself overly attached to the characters and crying every time you either die or lose another. Great game, beautiful art, and touching story, 10/10”[/i] [b]– [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/434000/Paws/#app_reviews_hash]Charlie Foxtrot[/url][/b]

[i]“This game is beautiful and wonderful. Just from the beginning, you can tell that Might and Delight put lots of work into the designs and patterns in the forest. I say that this game is adorable and takes you on a little lynx's journey throughout her first steps. Get ready for a roller coaster!”[/i] [b]– [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/434000/Paws/#app_reviews_hash]BCJImagine026[/url][/b]

[previewyoutube=I9sn0ERcc2s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Scoring Shelter Games
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]

The release of Shelter 3 is just on the horizon, and in the third of our posts celebrating its predecessors, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/977630]Shelter 3[/url], we’re exploring the musical style that’s such a huge part of the personality of Shelter games. And to share in full spirit, we’re [b]giving away the full Shelter 2 soundtrack[/b] as a free gift in our [url=https://shelter.mightanddelight.com. ]Shelter newsletter[/url]. We could all use a little musical sunshine in these dark days! Take a listen to the theme song right here...
[previewyoutube=_Pc3V85_ez4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Scoring for Wilderness[/h2]
 
The soundtracks for all Shelter games are composed and performed by [b]Swedish band Retro Family, [/b]who work in close collaboration with the developers. Shelter’s uniquely loose and live sound began as a quest for “a sound that would blend nicely with the ambience of nature” says Sound Designer Josef Tuulse, “I also wanted to leave space in the spectrum for the calls of the badgers. We came up with a soundtrack that was [b]quite heavy on the low end and shimmering in the highs[/b], where the voice of the guitar can express freely and comment on the narrative.” 

In life and in gameplay, intuition is what being an animal is all about, and [b]an intuitive, emotive approach also leads the musical composition[/b]. Retro Family’s Ulf Wahlgren explains: “Jokke is very good at creating sounds and feelings in the studio, so it's more about that then the actual instruments for Shelter.” The studio’s philosophy is to leave the player to interpret their play experience, and sound design plays a big role in setting that tone. As Ulf says, “The music for Shelter is about 25% avant-garde, I always feel that this genre [b]lets the listener decide what it feels like[/b]. White noise will be beautiful and soothing to some, yet scary and claustrophobic to others.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/7f7abb26c52f2bf56c397b01110bda77fa511df3.png[/img]

[h2]Music for Elephants[/h2]
 
Due for release in quarter two this year, Shelter 3 will see the series move from tundra to jungle and from lynx family to elephant herd. So what might we expect from a Shelter 3 soundtrack? “We want to give players all the comfort of returning to the Shelter universe as well as something new,” says Josef, “Elephants are [b]big and heavy but also gentle and caring.[/b] It's our aim to give these same qualities to the music”
 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/502aad74261b8315879d06dec6e739e84b0f23c8.png[/img]
 
[h2]Celebrating music in our games[/h2]
 
[b]Retro Family are Ulf Wahlgren, Jokke Pettersson and Alfred Andersson [/b]and are also working on music for Book of Travels which we’ve also featured in this week’s Steam post. You can watch some studio jams at Retro Family’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCAoe5b6PCwDIcpI_-cRgItw]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/retrofamilymusic/]Instagram[/url]. 
 
We’d love to hear what you think about the music in any of our games - what do you like about it? What does it remind you of?[b] Let us know right here in the comments[/b] or drop us a line in the Youtube video comments box! 
 
If you’re new to Shelter Games we’d love to hear from you. Say hello in the comments right here and we’ll pop in to respond! And to find out more about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/244710/Shelter/]Shelter[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/275100/Shelter_2/]Shelter 2[/url] and more, check out this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/]overview,[/url] or take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/]Shelter books and unlockable DLCs[/url].
 
That’s all for now, thank you so much for spending time with us!
 
[b]Best Wishes,
 
Helen and the Shelter Team
[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/

[h2]Want more info?[/h2]
Join the herd by [url=shelter.mightanddelight.com]signing up to our mailing list[/url] for news and free gifts. The first gift is a Steam key for TMO spin-off game, Meadow, a free comic book and soundtrack will arrive in your inbox with the following two emails!

If you missed our earlier post about our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/977630/view/2909853883456414996]books, check it out here[/url], and if you want to talk to other Shelter lovers join our super friendly [url=https://discord.gg/Yq9C8Yf]Discord[/url] where people talk about all kinds of things including books, art, music, and travel as well as our upcoming TMORPG, [url=http://www.TMORPG.com]Book of Travels[/url].

notes.title: Four Books from the World of Shelter
notes.content:
There are many things about Might and Delight that make us a little bit different, and one of those is that as well as games we’ve also made books. To date we’ve published five illustrated books set in the world of[i] Shelter[/i], they comprise [b]two living books, three wordless comic books and a picture book. [/b]Today we want to let you know a little bit about them and show you how you can get some of them (almost all of them!) for free!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/0081a6ddbb1499e124bcc587131b5f2d8aaf522c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fables from the Den[/h2]
[b]A living book from the world of Shelter[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/504790/Fables_from_the_Den/][i]Fables from the Den[/i][/url] is a living book using concept art from [i]Meadow[/i]. The papery, watercolour aesthetic and atmospheric audio provide the backdrop to [b]fables told by the animals from their underground den.[/b] [i]Meadow[/i] players will recognise this den as the place where they select their player-animal and set out on an adventure – see that den in a whole new light after reading [i]Fables from the Den.[/i]

[h3]What does it unlock in Meadow?[/h3]
Owning [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/504790/Fables_from_the_Den/][i]Fables from the Den[/i][/url]  will unlock a 3D raincloud emote in[i] Meadow.
[/i]
[h3]How can I get it?[/h3]
Fables from the Den is currently just under $3.00 on Steam or comes as part of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13317/Shelter_Bundle/?utm_source=Indie_Game_Bundle_93&utm_medium=Steam-Post&utm_campaign=Steam_Winter_Sale2020]Shelter Bundle[/url] (currently down by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13317/Shelter_Bundle/?utm_source=Indie_Game_Bundle_93&utm_medium=Steam-Post&utm_campaign=Steam_Winter_Sale2020]85% in the Steam Winter Sale[/url]).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/7b373ff1fe19aae1fd407422d9f68d55a1563c73.jpg[/img]

[h2]Blossom, Symbols and Trails[/h2]
[b]Comics about a lynx family from the world of Shelter 2 [/b]

Told entirely with illustrations and emotes, [i]Blossom, Symbols[/i] and [i]Trails[/i] tell stories about a lynx cub and their family. These wordless comics were made by [b]Lisa Richardson, a [i]Meadow [/i]fan with a deep appreciation for [i]Meadow[/i] emotes,[/b] after she shared her artwork on the [i]Meadow[/i] community hub. Since we’d made books before, it seemed that working with Lisa to make another was a perfect collaboration.

[h3]What does it unlock in Meadow?[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942280/Symbols_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Symbols[/i][/url] in your library will unlock the wolf in[i] Meadow[/i], while owning [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179550/Trails_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Trails[/i][/url] also unlocks a wolf skin and 3D butterfly emote. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/813460/Blossom_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Blossom[/i][/url] unlocks a wolf and cub skin and a 3D counting flower emote.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/e444790f5f41a5ab4b43c91d51132a0b12087393.jpg[/img]

[h3]How can I get them?[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1179550/Trails_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Trails[/i][/url] also comes as a free gift in  [url=https://m-n-d.games/Shelter-Steam-Post_signup?utm_source=Steam-Post&utm_medium=4-books_text-mention]part two of our newsletter[/url]. You'll need to install Meadow with the free key from your welcome email first. (Watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UXQamwYRewY&feature=youtu.be&ab_channel=MightandDelight]this brief video[/url] on how to access them) You can pick up [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/813460/Blossom_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Blossom[/i][/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/942280/Symbols_A_Meadow_comic_book/][i]Symbols[/i][/url] individually on Steam or as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13317/Shelter_Bundle/]Shelter Bundle[/url] deal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/c8e42ef508cda9935fd5e4d0697938e9499004bb.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Lonesome Fog [/h2]
[b]A living book about bear cubs from the world of [i]Meadow[/i][/b]

Take a look at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/446830/The_Lonesome_Fog/][i]the Lonesome Fog[/i][/url] and you’ll see just what this we-had-to-make-it-up format offers – the gently animated scenery really brings the wildlife setting to life. The story follows a small bear cub and celebrates the peculiar magic of chance meetings. [i]Meadow[/i] players will know how central that magic is to the game and in this case, a chance meeting proves both a comfort and a secret treasure.


[h3]What does it  unlock in Meadow?[/h3]
Adding [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/446830/The_Lonesome_Fog/][i]the Lonesome Fog[/i][/url] to your Steam library unlocks the 3D fog emote.

[h3]How can I get it?[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/446830/The_Lonesome_Fog/][i]the Lonesome Fog[/i][/url] is a DLC available on Steam for just under $2.00 and is [b]also part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13317/Shelter_Bundle/]Shelter Bundle.[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34813752/bd3b1114e2fd88deb49623660546b23aa8b9546f.jpg[/img]

[h2]The Circle [/h2]
[b]A picture book about badgers from the first [i]Shelter[/i] game[/b]

The first ever Might and Delight book was made by the team to explore one of the main themes in [i]Shelter,[/i] the circle of life. This simple story presents the simple and powerful logic of nature in one striking image – but we won’t tell you what it is! Take a look instead and then tell us what you think!

[h3]What does it unlock in Meadow?[/h3]
[i]The Circle [/i] is the only book that doesn’t unlock anything but the good news is that it is free to download [url=https://mightanddelight.com/files/theCircle.pdf]right here.[/url]

Thank you so much for taking the time to get to know us and our books. We hope you have as good a holiday as this world allows for this year, and we look forward to sharing more with you in the run up to release of Shelter 2 at the end of February – so very close now!

[b]Best Wishes,

Helen and the Shelter 3 team.[/b]

[b]PS. Don't forget to sign up to our [url=https://m-n-d.games/Shelter-Steam-Post_signup?utm_source=Steam-Post&utm_medium=4-books_CTA-text_end-PS]Shelter newsletter[/url] – and get Meadow for free as a signup gift.[/b]

notes.title: A Game Dev Journey in Three Animals
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
Thanks to the [i]Book of Travels[/i][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/bookoftravels/book-of-travels-a-serene-online-rpg] Kickstarter[/url], we've seen many [b]new players in the world of Shelter this last year,[/b] so if you're one of them (or even if you're a Shelter officiando!), we think you'll find something to like in this little guide. And in the weeks to come, we'll be sharing more stories and fun facts about the series. (And if you haven't already, you can wishlist the game with the button at the end of this post.)

[h3]Badgers! The very first Shelter game[/h3]
[i]Shelter[/i] was released in 2013, and was [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/mightanddelight/]Might and Delight’s[/url][/b] second release as a newly formed studio. You can watch the Announce trailer here:

[previewyoutube=ifMWBd4CIZs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What are its defining features?  [/h3][list][*] [i]Shelter[/i] is a linear adventure where you play as a badger looking after her cubs
[*] The setting is both naturalistic and harsh – threats and dangers are many, and bereavement is highly likely
[*] The game’s graphical style – nature inspired geometrical patterns and textures – sets it apart from other animal games[/list]
[h3]What the developers say[/h3]
[i]“We knew we wanted to make a game with an animal-player and we’d intended to make something casual and somewhat quiet. In the end we had something that was both of those things but also very emotional, and it reached a much wider audience than we’d hoped for. We had no idea we’d be here, seven years later, working on Shelter 3!”[/i] 
– [b]Andreas Wangler,[/b] Game Designer

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
[i]“I didn’t care about my little cubs because the game told me to or because they were labelled my babies. I cared due to the way they followed me, how small they were, the little noises they made, and how quickly the hostile world around me took them away” [/i]
– [b]Wirdjos[/b] on Discord 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/244710/Shelter

[h2]Lynx! Protect your cubs in Shelter 2[/h2]
[i]Shelter 2[/i] was released in 2015 from our current site on an island in Stockholm. 

[previewyoutube=Tk-1M1wNVDY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What are its defining features?[/h3][list][*][i] Shelter 2[/i] is non-linear and open world: expect a greater variety of story experiences
[*] Players meet a somewhat more gentle (but no less moving) ending than they do in [i]Shelter[/i]
[*] Not all aspects of the game are informed by naturalistic observations – mysterious occurrences feature
[*] As opposed to [i]Shelter[/i], food is a moving target, players need to hunt to stay alive 
[*] Shelter 2 has a higher graphical profile and is the first Might and Delight game to be published on Switch[/list]
[h3]What the developers say [/h3]
[i]“Shelter 2 was an opportunity to explore a much less linear game design, instead we wanted to invite players to roam freely with no other goal than to rear their cubs to adulthood. We also wanted to introduce something a bit mysterious and otherworldly into the game” [/i]
[b]– Peter Stråhle[/b], 2D Artis

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
[i]“It's not just about motherhood and nature exposed in such a raw but gentle way, it's about the discovery of life through these young creatures whose life cycle revolves around finding their home, their Shelter” [/i]
[b]– Pencil[/b] on Discord

http://store.steampowered.com/app/275100/Shelter_2/

[h2]Elephants! Lead the herd in Shelter 3 [/h2]
[i]Shelter 3’[/i]s due for release on Q1 of 2021 - elephants are already roaming and testing is well under way.

[previewyoutube=UmqrVpFa2OU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What are its defining features?[/h3]
[list]
[*] The third in the series has players looking after a whole herd of elephants
[*] As a result, play will be slower, but the need for food will be even more pressing
[*] Players will enjoy a sense of community with other elephants
[*] The theme shifts from motherhood and family to legacy and inheritance[/list]
[h3]What the developers say[/h3]
[i]“Until now, Shelter games have focussed on animal families. With [i]Shelter 3[/i], we had a strong feeling that we wanted to make a Shelter experience that’s more social – elephants are incredibly sociable and that allows us to create a very different game experience”[/i] 
[b]– Sofia Papworth[/b], Lead Programmer

[h3]What the players say[/h3]
We're too early for player testimonies, but we’d love to know what you think about our plans for[i] Shelter 3[/i] – please drop us a line or two in the comments section here or join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Yq9C8Yf]Discord[/url]!

Did you know that there's also a multiplayer game from the Shelter world, called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/486310/Meadow/]Meadow[/url]? In Meadow you can meet other players and communicate with emotes, but we'll save that for another post!

------------------------

We hope you enjoyed this little potted history – please go ahead and let us know what your experience of the different Shelter games is in the comments section below! If you didn’t find us through our brand new newsletter then [b][url=https://mightanddelight.com/shelter]you can sign up here[/url][/b]. And if you’d like to wishlist [i]Shelter 3[/i], here’s the button!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/977630/Shelter_3/

[h2]Best Wishes, and thanks for spending time with us![/h2]

Helen and the Shelter 3 Dev Team x[/b]


------------------------

PS. We've made [url=https://m-n-d.games/Shelter_Bundle_-_Steam-post-TEXT-link]a bundle[/url] with all the released games and DLCs in the Shelter Universe – it unlocks lots of skins, sounds and emotes in Meadow, and comes with a 50% discount – you can check it out 
[url=https://m-n-d.games/Shelter_Bundle_-_Steam-post-TEXT-link/]here:[/url]

[h1]Every Month a Creature[/h1]

For each month until the release of Shelter 3 next year, we'll be placing[b] ten statues of an animal from Shelter 3 in the Meadow world. [h1]
Spot the Crocs!

Next you'll be able to hunt low slung crocs across the game world - check them out on podium number two and keep your eyes peeled! We hope you enjoy seeking them out and showing the way and sharing your findings, and best of all, there is absolutely no rush.

notes.title: Thank you for Fantastic Anniversary! + New Statue Hunts
notes.content:

[h1]Hello![/h1]


A great big thank you to all of you who shared and played our Anniversary Play Event last weekend: we broke our 10k player target and raised a welcome donation for [url=www.safeinourworld.org]Safe in Our World.[/url] We saw lots of you sharing the event on your social channels and some of you helping newbies around the place, and we do appreciate that for a fair few of you the Meadow was a little more crowded than you're used to - so thanks for sharing your space for the party <3

We're glad you enjoyed helping one another visit them all, and we've heard that many of you don't feel super keen on time limited achievements, so we'll be putting them back for another ten days, which we hope will be enough time for new players to find them all and will allow previous ones to finish up. Expect to see them some time on May 5th. We might add a few extra too, more info on that next week. You'll get achievements for the first, fifth and tenth elephant that you visit.

[h1]More Shelter 3 statues to come...[/h1]

The elephants were so popular that we thought we'd make some more statues for you to find, so in the next couple of months we'll be dropping a different kind of animal in for another ten days. Every animal will be from Shelter 3, and our first new animal will be appearing in June.

We hope this is good news for you and thanks again for a really great super feel good anniversary weekend!

Best Wishes and Stay Safe!

Helen and the Team

notes.title: Free Weekend of Meadow + Charity Play Event for our Tenth Anniversary

For the duration of the play event all profit from our Steam sales will go to charity Safe in Our World, and if we get 10,000 players joining us in #Meadow we'll add 25% to that donation - so please join us, bring your friends along... and help us get to 10,000 players by sharing the event on Twitter and beyond!

[b]
Stay safe and be well,

Helen and the team xx[/b]

notes.title: Shelter 3 New Trailer
notes.content:
[h2]Hello! [/h2]

Today we're really excited to share this, our new trailer! We hope you like it. Much like an elephant, development is coming along slowly but surely. Currently the team are working on elephant behaviours, level design and bringing some animal NPCs to life.

[previewyoutube=UmqrVpFa2OU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Elephant Development[/h3]

But we would like to be further along than this by now, and today we're writing to let you know that we've had to revise our schedule - release is now set for a realistic early 2021. We're sorry - we know that some of you have been waiting so patiently! But we're a small team and along with updating [i]Meadow[/i], we just don't have the resources to move much faster than this. This means that we won't be working on any new updates for [i]Meadow[/i] until [i]Shelter 3[/i] is released. Pulling resources away from [i]Meadow[/i] means that we can fully commit to our deadline for [i]Shelter 3, [/i]however we [i]do[/i] have plans for some fun[i] Meadow [/i]updates when that time comes - we think it will be worth the wait!

[h3]Meadow in the Meantime[/h3]

[i]Meadow[/i] has been an unexpected high point in our journey and we want to say a huge thank you for making [i]Meadow[/i] what it is today - it's been four years of animal joy, and we've never stopped being surprised, touched and deeply grateful for all that you have produced and shared. [b]Thank you. [/b]

Our recent Kickstarter means that there's been a few new faces in [i]Meadow[/i] recently, and we'll continue to do more Play-with-the-devs events (one soon-to-be-announced for April). We also want you to know that the emotes you've been using so effectively will be gaining a sibling in our upcoming fairytale RPG, [i]Book of Travels.[/i] Again, to all [i]Meadow[/i] players, a huge thank you for helping us test and develop this communication system and showing us how magical it can be.

That's all for now - thank you for all your comments here on Steam!

[b]Best Wishes,

Helen and the team at Might & Delight [/b]

[i](This is a reposting made necessary while we tidy up our Steam pages - thank you for your patience!)[/i]
